pos.personaBrief: Flamengo under Dorival liked to keep the ball and dominate (A Gazeta, Driblab: attacking, elaborate football with possession), so possession is both control and defence.

pro.personaBrief: Possession-based, elaborate football with quick recovery high up and a simple, objective system (Drible de Corpo); patient but vertical when space opens.

est.personaBrief: The losango and 4-3-3 gave an impression of rigidity but with constant movement and position swaps (Aug 2022 column), with wingers staying wide and a mobile Arrascaeta and strikers.

lar.personaBrief: 4-3-3 with Marinho as right winger and Cebolinha open on the left, plus a losango with Arrascaeta in the middle after Bruno Henrique's injury: both routes used, wide wingers valued.

blo.personaBrief: Team pressed the opposing build-up and recovered quickly in the opposition half (A Gazeta, Driblab), with collective commitment to reducing space.

mar.personaBrief: No source states the marking scheme; the collective, space-reducing recomposition and simple system suggest a zonal default without dedicated man-markers.

pla.personaBrief: Dorival did not invent: kept a simple, own possession-and-pressing style, adapting to the squad he found (two teams, losango after injury) more than to opponents.

res.personaBrief: Result-driven winner of Copa do Brasil and Libertadores, yet with an attacking, proactive Flamengo that pressed to win rather than settle.

sis.personaBrief: Simple system with everyone doing the job: Everton Ribeiro and Gabigol accepted collective roles and tracked back, while stars like Arrascaeta kept freedom within it.

jog.personaBrief: Technical Flamengo squad (Arrascaeta, Everton Ribeiro, Gabigol) with high intensity in recovery; technique favoured over pure physical duels.

bas.personaBrief: Used a star-heavy squad and a reserve team, while also promoting academy youngsters like Victor Hugo and João Gomes; titles came with experienced core.

lid.personaBrief: Harmony-oriented man manager: stars like Gabigol and Everton Ribeiro accepted lesser roles and players publicly thanked him (Agência Brasil, Drible de Corpo).
